questions.prompt:
Official NSC · Nov 2022 · English HL Paper 1 · Question 1.1

Choose the correct sentence.

options.text: Neither the learners nor the teacher was ready.
Neither the learners nor the teacher were ready.
Neither the learners nor the teacher is ready.
Neither the learners nor the teacher are ready.

questions.explanation: With neither/nor, the verb agrees with the nearer subject (teacher → was).

questions.prompt:
Official NSC · Nov 2022 · English HL Paper 1 · Question 2.1

Define the term "metaphor" as used in poetry analysis.
questions.correctAnswerText: direct comparison without like or as
acceptableAnswers: A figure of speech comparing two things without using like or as
questions.explanation: A metaphor states one thing is another to create imagery or meaning.
